description: Knowledge Base of company facts, processes, voice and support guidance. kind: guide = the one Operating Guide; procedure = numbered steps + whenToUse; default knowledge. list: 5 per page, or pageSize up to 100, guide pinned first, remaining pages in saved order; chars is the length of a page's Markdown. search: hasMore marks further pages; total is a lower bound unless totalIsExact. Returns snippets, section offsets and section anchors, plus didYouMean when a misspelled word was corrected. get: one Markdown chunk of up to 5,500 characters, or maxChars up to 20,000 (outline at 0, each heading with its section anchor); nextOffset is the offset of the following chunk and null at the end; updatedAt changes when the page changed between chunks; anchor reads one section. An anchor is unique within its page: a repeated heading takes -2, -3 and so on. The first chunk names up to 8 pages that link to this page (linkedFrom, linkedFromTotal); linkedFromIncomplete and, on links, syncing mark a list that is still being read. owner and verifiedAt appear when set; verifiedAt is when someone last confirmed the page, updatedAt when its text last changed. links: with id, the pages that link to the page (linkedFrom), the pages it links to (linksTo), linked page ids that no longer exist (missingPageIds) and the record lists it links into; without id, the pages no other page links to (orphans) and the pages with links to deleted pages (broken), 50 each with totals. update: edits change parts of a page (find and replace one exact text, replace or insert beside a section by its anchor, or add at the start or end) without resending the whole markdown; the result carries totalChars, and a page holds at most 65,535 characters. move: places page id before or after targetId in the saved order; the Operating Guide stays pinned first, so it can neither move nor serve as targetId. gaps: questions the Knowledge Base could not answer (editors). delete moves the page to Trash, where it is deleted permanently after 30 days; the returned trashBatchId identifies the Trash batch it can be restored from. Pages link as /wiki?page=<id>; ids survive renames.

action.description: list: page, pageSize, kind; search: query, page; get: id, offset or anchor, maxChars; links: id; create: pages, requireEmpty; update: id, expectedUpdatedAt, title, markdown, edits, kind, whenToUse, owner, verified; move: id, targetId, placement; delete: id, expectedUpdatedAt. update changes only the supplied fields, at least one of them, as top-level fields, and takes markdown or edits, not both. links without id reports on the whole Knowledge Base.

anchor.description: Section anchor as returned by a search hit or the outline; get returns only that section.

edits.description: update only, in place of markdown: changes to parts of the page, applied in order and all or none, so a long page is not resent. Each edit is one of: find with replace; anchor with markdown; markdown alone.

anchor.description: Section anchor from a search hit or the outline. With find it limits the search to that section; with markdown it names the section to replace or to insert beside. A section runs from its heading to the following heading of any level.

find.description: Exact text to replace, copied from a get of this page. It must occur exactly once in the page, or with anchor exactly once in that section; include more surrounding text when it occurs more often.

markdown.description: Markdown with actual newline characters; escaped backslash-n separators are rejected.

placement.description: With anchor and markdown: replace (default) swaps the section including its heading, before or after inserts beside it. With markdown alone: end (default) or start of the page.

replace.description: Text that takes the place of find; an empty text removes it.

markdown.description: Markdown with actual newline characters; escaped backslash-n separators are rejected.

maxChars.description: get only: the most characters one response holds, 2500 to 20000. Default 5500; a larger value reads a long page in fewer chunks.

owner.description: update only: who keeps the page current, a person, a team or an agent; null clears it.

pageSize.description: list only: pages per response, 1 to 100. Default 5; 100 returns the inventory of most Knowledge Bases at once.

markdown.description: Markdown with actual newline characters; escaped backslash-n separators are rejected.

owner.description: Who keeps the page current: a person, a team or an agent.

placement.description: move only: before or after targetId in the saved order.

requireEmpty.description: Only into an empty Knowledge Base.

targetId.description: move only: the reference page this page is placed beside.

verified.description: update only: true records that the page was checked against its sources and is still correct. verifiedAt becomes now; updatedAt moves only when the content changes.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: manage_wiki_pages

linkedFrom.description: Pages that link to this page; a rename, split or delete of the page affects them.

linkedFromIncomplete.description: The pages that link to this page could not all be read yet, so linkedFrom may miss some.

missingPageIds.description: Linked page ids that no longer name a live page.

outlineTruncated.description: Some headings were omitted to keep the response bounded.
